Oracle’s Trillion-Dollar Ghostwriter

The company’s stock surge had a secret ingredient beyond AI hype: a clever way to get someone else to pay for it. If you blinked this spring, you missed it. While the S&P 500 ambled to a respectable 9.5% gain, Oracle (ORCL) quietly bolted ahead by 42.3%.
